movies.title: The Mysterious Gaze of the Flamingo
movies.synopsis: As an unknown and deadly disease begins to spread, legend has it that it is transmitted between two men, through a simple glance, when they fall in love. While people are accusing her family, Lidia must find out whether this myth is real or not.

movies.title: Moment of Contact: New Revelations of Alien Encounters
movies.synopsis: For the first time in history a neurosurgeon describes communication with a live captured alien. This expanded version of Moment of Contact, New Revelations of Alien Encounters sees James Fox return to Brazil in the wake of congressional hearings in the United States. Ground-breaking interviews with former police chief, pathologists, and Dr Ítalo Venturelli who communicated with the alien.

movies.title: Front Row
movies.synopsis: Bertolt Brecht asked whether there would be singing in the dark times. In the throes of war, the United Ukrainian Ballet Company defiantly insists there will be dancing, too. Far from the land they call home, young dancers take quiet comfort from art. For a while, their work feels like the old days, except there is a new troupe member: a soldier learning to dance with prosthetic legs.

movies.title: Monkeying Around
movies.synopsis: Meet Roddy, a 22 year old adoptee from Africa and aspiring actor. He also happens to be an Ape

movies.title: Urchin
movies.synopsis: Mike, a rough sleeper in London, is trapped in a cycle of self-destruction as he attempts to turn his life around. Along the way, he encounters unexpected chances for a fresh start.

movies.title: Blue Moon
movies.synopsis: On the evening of March 31, 1943, legendary lyricist Lorenz Hart confronts his shattered self-confidence in Sardi’s bar as his former collaborator, Richard Rodgers, celebrates the opening night of his ground-breaking hit musical, “Oklahoma!”

movies.title: If I Had Legs I'd Kick You
movies.synopsis: With her life crashing down around her, Linda attempts to navigate her child's mysterious illness, her absent husband, a missing person, and an increasingly hostile relationship with her therapist.

movies.title: Escobank
movies.synopsis: A ragtag group of misfits, veterans and ex-cons embark on a perilous journey in the jungles of Colombia to find the buried barrels of cash left behind by legendary drug kingpin Pablo Escobar before his downfall.

movies.title: Don't Trip
movies.synopsis: After getting fired from his assistant job, a young struggling screenwriter hatches a plan to befriend a powerful producer’s troubled nepo-baby son in order to sell his screenplay. But when the nepo-baby learns of his plan things go awry.

movies.title: December
movies.synopsis: Amid December’s festive glow, refugees remain hidden in forests along the Poland-Belarus border. This powerful documentary gives voice to their silent cries.

movies.title: Bone Hill
movies.synopsis: A psychiatrist tries to save a young female patient whose psychoses might hold the key to ending an ancient evil.

movies.title: Mean Boys
movies.synopsis: A high school outcast navigates the pressures of social media fame while entangled with popular jocks, bisexual romantic dynamics, and escalating drug use. Set at a flashy Los Angeles school open to all sexualities, conflicts unfold amid parties, school drama, and crushes, leading to increasingly destructive situations.

movies.title: The Grieving
movies.synopsis: Mia, a mourning daughter, attempts to lay her father to rest, only to uncover the dangerous demons he was battling. As she struggles to make sense of a world without him, grief gives way to a chilling truth.

movies.title: Bird Boy
movies.synopsis: August, a troubled young orphan, finds an abandoned ostrich egg and raises a giant, bird-brained best friend. When his ostrich is taken away, August risks everything to get him back.

movies.title: The Nutcracker at the Jacobs School of Music
movies.synopsis: An imaginative retelling of the classic ballet, featuring a full orchestral performance and stunning choreography. A colorful blend of live theater with cinematic artistry. Breathtaking scenic design combines with elaborate costumes and elegant dance. Captured live at the Musical Arts Center at Indiana University, this presentation creates a new holiday tradition for audiences of all ages.

movies.title: A Map of the World in Time
movies.synopsis: Over 34 days at sea, deep in the Arctic Circle, the wages of knowledge are explored. This ship's mariners and scientists reflect on their life at sea as they attempt to better understand climate change, both past and present.

movies.title: Holiday in the Hamptons
movies.synopsis: A woman is left her grandfather's home in the Hamptons and reconnects with her childhood love.

movies.title: Gary
movies.synopsis: Follow the extraordinary story of Gary Coleman's rise to international fame as the child star of Diff'rent Strokes; his struggles with fame; and the controversy surrounding his tragic death at the age of 42. For the first time, viewers will get insight into Coleman's private world through exclusive interviews with his fellow actors, industry insiders and his estranged ex-wife and parents.

movies.title: Where Olive Trees Weep
movies.synopsis: Where Olive Trees Weep offers a searing window into the struggles and resilience of the Palestinian people under Israeli occupation. It explores themes of loss, trauma, and the quest for justice.

movies.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
movies.synopsis: After finding a host body in investigative reporter Eddie Brock, the alien symbiote must face a new enemy, Carnage, the alter ego of serial killer Cletus Kasady.

movies.title: Making Wicked: For Good
movies.synopsis: Return to Oz for a fantastic behind-the-scenes journey with this expansive look inside the characters, choreography, and creativity that make up the movie's unforgettable world.

movies.title: Real Korean Cooking Stories
movies.synopsis: In a heart touching documentary celebrating the 10 year anniversary of her bestselling first book, YouTube chef Maangchi cooks with her family, friends, and fans.

movies.title: Bad Men Must Bleed
movies.synopsis: After a young girl’s family is brutally murdered by ruthless outlaw Harrison Griggs, she forms an unlikely bond with a haunted Civil War veteran turned fugitive known as 'The Butcher'. Together, they must stop Griggs and his gang before he seizes control of the town.

movies.title: A Little Prayer
movies.synopsis: A loving father grapples with how to protect his daughter-in-law when he discovers that his son is having an affair in a sensitive and searching portrait of a Southern family.

movies.title: Amityville La Llorona
movies.synopsis: A married couple, reeling from loss, are thrust into a nightmarish situation when a demonic entity invades their guesthouse.

movies.title: Bambi: The Reckoning
movies.synopsis: After a mother and son get in a car wreck, they soon become hunted by Bambi, a mutated grief-stricken deer on a deadly rampage seeking revenge for the death of his mother and wife.

movies.title: The Mother's Eye
movies.synopsis: A harrowing night unfolds when a woman realizes she's being hunted by a serial killer.

movies.title: Ballerina
movies.synopsis: Taking place during the events of John Wick: Chapter 3 – Parabellum, Eve Macarro begins her training in the assassin traditions of the Ruska Roma.

movies.title: Lovebug
movies.synopsis: Set in 1988 Los Angeles, Douglass, a young man, winds up convinced by his new and older girlfriend, Gracie, to become a pornstar under her management.

movies.title: The Jolly Monkey
movies.synopsis: 40 years ago, families disappeared near the isolated Jolly Monkey motel. Today, the family of the owners return to discuss what to do with the place. One by one they are killed by a someone dressed as the motel's mascot and need to escape.

movies.title: Viper
movies.synopsis: A trio of covert operatives in an elite group of assassins-for-hire are bound by the strictest code of conduct: no romantic entanglements.

movies.title: Buffalo Kids
movies.synopsis: In 1886, orphaned Irish siblings Mary and Tom arrive in New York City via ocean liner, and quickly find themselves on a wild, cross-country journey aboard a transcontinental 'Orphan Train', where they meet an extraordinary new friend who will change their lives forever.

movies.title: Dead Mountaineer's Hotel
movies.synopsis: The police get a call-out to a lonely hotel in the Alps. When an officer gets to the hotel everything seems to be alright. Suddenly, an avalanche cuts them off from the rest of the world and strange things start happening.

movies.title: Panji Tengkorak
movies.synopsis: Panji, who sold his soul to black magic to avenge his wife's death, intended to end his life, but found his body now shackled by black magic that controlled his soul. After wandering aimlessly, Panji met an old warrior who asked for his help to chase a bandit who had seized a sacred heirloom that was said to be able to eliminate the power of black magic. Panji accepted the offer that dragged him into a long war between two kingdoms and revealed the reality of his dark past.

movies.title: The Past Is Never Buried
movies.synopsis: Emily, desperate to find answers about her mother's murder 22 years prior, returns to her hometown when her father, also a suspect in her mother's death, is arrested for the homicide of a local teenager.

movies.title: The Tank
movies.synopsis: A German Tiger tank crew is sent on a dangerous mission to rescue the missing officer Paul von Hardenburg from a top-secret bunker behind enemy lines. As they make their way through the lethal no-man's land, they must confront not only the enemy, but also their own fears and inner demons. Fueled by the Wehrmacht's methamphetamine, their mission increasingly becomes a journey into the heart of darkness.

movies.title: Cheetahs Up Close with Bertie Gregory
movies.synopsis: Bertie arrives in the Serengeti as the spectacular wildebeest migration kicks off. He’s here to film the fastest land animal on Earth: the cheetah. As he gets close to a mother caring for her tiny cubs and a young group of males executing phenomenal hunts as a team, he learns about the unexpected challenges the species endures.

movies.title: Follow My Voice
movies.synopsis: After a health crisis that keeps her home, Klara does nothing but listen to her favorite radio show, Follow My Voice. But one day she wonders: is it possible to fall in love with someone she has only heard on the radio but never met? Could she really have feelings for Kang, the radio show host whose voice she has only heard once, and will she overcome her fears to step out into the world again?

movies.title: Dracula
movies.synopsis: In modern-day Transylvania, vampire hunts and labor strikes collide with sci-fi twists, romance, and AI-crafted tales, as multiple storylines blend folklore, classic horror, and contemporary elements into a fresh take on Dracula's legend.

movies.title: Rebbeca
movies.synopsis: As chart-topping Latin music superstar Becky G embarks on her most personal and ambitious project to date, her debut Mexican regional album, she is prompted to revisit her roots and dive deep into a beautiful and complicated past.

movies.title: Haq
movies.synopsis: In 1980s India, Shazia Bano takes her husband to court after he abandons her and their children, sparking a national battle over faith, women’s rights, and justice.

movies.title: Don't Follow Me
movies.synopsis: Obsessed with going viral with her videos of ghosts and paranormal events, aspiring influencer Carla moves into a famous haunted building. There, she begins faking ghostly apparitions to gain more followers, unaware that a real evil entity resides in her apartment and will torment her until no one, not even she, can distinguish what's real and what isn't.

movies.title: Lone Pup
movies.synopsis: 65 million years ago, a Tyrannosaurus Rex pup is separated from his parents and his clan. In order to find them, he must brave erupting volcanoes, stampedes, and attacks from determined predators. Along the way, he befriends a young Triceratops, a band of prancing Oviraptors, and a family of Ankylosaurs, who all help him on his journey. But when he finally finds his family, about to go to war with a rival clan of T-Rex, the loyalties he has earned, and the skills he has learned from his adventures, help save the day.

movies.title: A Desert
movies.synopsis: A photographer’s road trip takes a dark turn when he befriends a reckless couple, plunging him into a nightmarish neo-noir spiral of unpredictable horror.

movies.title: Joan of Arc
movies.synopsis: Three siblings craft a knight-like figure, only to unleash a barrage of arrows upon it. Through the seasons, we observe their lives as they both construct and demolish their lifelike creation.

movies.title: Or Something
movies.synopsis: Two strangers show up at the same Brooklyn apartment to collect cash they’re both owed. Forced to spend the day together on a journey through New York City, the pair reveal intimate details about their lives. One of them happens to be hiding a harrowing secret.

movies.title: Eko
movies.synopsis: In the misty hills of Kaattukunnu, an aging woman and her servant boy struggle to survive the ghosts of the past, as the hunt for Kuriachan — a legendary dog breeder and outlaw — blurs the line between myth, memory, and vengeance, revealing that even in absence, he still rules the hills.

movies.title: Land of Sin
movies.synopsis: When a teenager goes missing, a detective with personal ties to the case joins a tense investigation that reveals fierce loyalties and old family feuds.

movies.title: Nobody Wants to Shoot a Woman
movies.synopsis: A stark portrait of a mother marginalized by society who embraces a violent crime spree as a means to survive.
movies.original_title: Nobody Wants to Shoot a Woman

movies.title: CMXXIV
movies.synopsis: Turkish comedy heavyweight Cem Yılmaz takes the stand-up stage in this dynamic special – covering everything from cancel culture to regretful tattoos.

movies.title: 100 METERS
movies.synopsis: A gifted runner trains a determined but unskilled classmate, unaware he's creating a rival who will challenge him on the track for years to come.

movies.title: Apple Music Live: Fred again..
movies.synopsis: Party into the new year with the DJ, who played an electrifying set in Dublin during his USB002 show, accompanied by his friends and guests.

movies.title: Run Away
movies.synopsis: A desperate father searching for his runaway daughter gets caught up in a murder case — and stumbles upon secrets which could destroy his family for good.

movies.title: Time Flies
movies.synopsis: Fresh out of prison and low on options, two women run a fumigation business — until a shady client pulls them back into the life they fought to escape.

movies.title: Ainsley McGregor Mysteries: A Case For the Watchmaker
movies.synopsis: Ainsley McGregor thought craft markets and book clubs, not corpses, would define her new life back home in Sweet River. That is until a beloved member of the book club raises a cold case involving her late husband who was found murdered over his rare antique watch. Ainsley springs into action to untangle a web of small town secrets before the killer winds the clock down on the next victim.
movies.original_title: Ainsley McGregor Mysteries: A Case For the Watchmaker

movies.title: Alien: Romulus
movies.synopsis: While scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station, a group of young space colonizers come face to face with the most terrifying life form in the universe.

movies.title: Sleepwalker
movies.synopsis: A grieving mother is haunted by the tragic loss of her daughter in a car accident that left her abusive husband in a coma. As she battles a surreal descent into darkness, her sleepwalking episodes intensify. Plagued by haunting visions of her husband inside their home, she grapples with the blurred lines between reality and nightmare.

movies.title: People We Meet on Vacation
movies.synopsis: Poppy's a free spirit. Alex loves a plan. After years of summer vacations, these polar-opposite pals wonder if they could be a perfect romantic match.

movies.title: Relentless
movies.synopsis: A homeless man targets a well-off elite in a home invasion. But it will take an unhinged level of brutality to find out his true motive.

movies.title: The Conspiracists
movies.synopsis: When two siblings’ dreams of building an all-inclusive conspiracy convention begin to shatter, its up to one of them to put the pieces back together while the other strives to uncover a bigger conspiracy at play.

movies.title: Oscar Shaw
movies.synopsis: After retiring from the police force, a relentless detective haunted by the tragic loss of his closest friend sets out on a perilous quest for vengeance, seeking redemption and fighting to restore justice to the streets he once swore to protect.

movies.title: De De Pyaar De 2
movies.synopsis: When Ashish meets his girlfriend's parents for the first time, their age difference sparks outrage and a madcap plot to drive him out of her life.

movies.title: Parable
movies.synopsis: Six strangers awake inside a loft with no memory of how they got there and no escape. A seventh individual lies lifeless on a bed. Hourglasses count down the minutes as they fight to find a way out.

movies.title: Marcello Hernández: American Boy
movies.synopsis: Filmed in Miami, Hernández's special features his comedic take on his first-generation American upbringing before a local audience.

movies.title: The Best Friend
movies.synopsis: Two great friends meet again after five years. Among so many things that have changed, the resumption of the bond awakens an old feeling for which they remain unprepared.

movies.title: A Night Like This
movies.synopsis: A stone-broke gay actor and a privileged screw-up with a failing business cross paths on a winter night and join forces in a quest around London to find a meaning to their miserable lives.

movies.title: Boss
movies.synopsis: Soon-tae, aspiring to start his dream restaurant franchise, is nominated as the next boss of the gang. He hopes to pass the role to Kang-pyo, the grandson of the former boss, but Kang-pyo dreams of becoming a tango dancer instead.

movies.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit
movies.synopsis: Three parents who have lost their children are involved with each other because of a deal; they have no soul in their eyes and hatred in their hearts, and each of them sets out on the road of seeking revenge.

movies.title: A Bird Flew In
movies.synopsis: Charts six interlinked narratives after the cast and crew of a film are sent home from set.

movies.title: Onimasa: A Japanese Godfather
movies.synopsis: Onimasa is the egocentric boss of a small yakuza clan on Shikoku Island, whose criminal duties conflict with his self-image as a chivalrous samurai.

movies.title: Tokyo Bordello
movies.synopsis: A ruined businessman was forced to sell his daughter, Hisano, to a brothel in Yoshiwara, the largest red-light district in Tokyo.

movies.title: Ancestry Road
movies.synopsis: When Kevin's daughter continually goes missing up the back of their Scottish farm, he builds a road to make life easier. Yet when deceased family members begin arriving in their cars for a visit, everything changes.

movies.title: Zodiac Killer Project
movies.synopsis: Against the backdrop of deserted spaces, a filmmaker explores his abandoned Zodiac Killer documentary, delving into the true crime genre's inner workings at a saturation point.

movies.title: Predator: Badlands
movies.synopsis: Cast out from his clan, a young Predator finds an unlikely ally in a damaged android and embarks on a treacherous journey in search of the ultimate adversary.

movies.title: Self-Help
movies.synopsis: A young woman infiltrates a dangerous self-actualization community after her mother becomes entangled with its enigmatic leader.

movies.title: The R.I.P Man
movies.synopsis: As a serial killer with a peculiar oral disease continues to murder teenagers in a quaint town, a determined detective attempts to piece together the killer's identity and motivations. The grizzly teeth gimmick murders overshadow the normally safe opulent area, as a vulnerable young man, must revisit his unknown past and put an end to the gruesome death.

movies.title: D(e)AD
movies.synopsis: Tillie, a floundering young woman and her charismatic, alcoholic father, struggle to resolve their fractured relationship in the weirdest possible way: after he dies, his ghost appears in mirrors to haunt everyone in the family but Tillie. Tillie’s family must do everything they can to make Tillie see her father or else they will be plagued by this ghost forever.

movies.title: Chain Reactions
movies.synopsis: An exploration of the legacy of Tobe Hooper's classic 'The Texas Chainsaw Massacre'.

movies.title: The Bosk
movies.synopsis: Stranded in a snowy forest, best friends Kim and Erin realize they're not alone ‒ something sinister watches from the trees.

movies.title: Not Without Hope
movies.synopsis: A group of friends' fishing boat capsizes off the coast of Mexico and they're left alone stranded at sea and struggling for survival.

movies.title: HIS & HERS
movies.synopsis: Two estranged spouses — one a detective, the other a news reporter — vie to solve a murder in which each believes the other is a prime suspect.

movies.title: Girl Taken
movies.synopsis: Follow the story of twin sisters Lily and Abby, whose lives are shattered when Lily is abducted from their quiet rural English town by beloved local teacher Rick Hansen. After years of abuse in captivity, Lily escapes - only to discover that freedom brings its own challenges.

movies.title: Spring Fever
movies.synopsis: After moving to a quiet rural town to heal from past heartbreak, a withdrawn teacher slowly rediscovers warmth and joy through her unexpected connection with a rough-around-the-edges but kindhearted local man.

movies.title: UFO Hunters II: Tales from the Universe
movies.synopsis: Someone from above has been observing us since the dawn of time... Some Italian ufologists retrace various historical events connected to UFO sightings and close encounters with extraterrestrial entities. In this journey back in time, the stories collected from various folk tales, essays, novels and religious books, will be narrated trying to confirm the reality of a form of life far from the parameters of human existence.
movies.original_title: UFO Hunters II: Tales from the Universe
